mapper.select: select id as levelId, title, description, time_limit_sec as timeLimitSec, slot_limit as slotLimit, poem_count as poemCount from game_poem_match_level where id = #{levelId} and status = 1 limit 1

select f.id as fragmentId, g.id as groupId, g.poem_title as poemTitle, g.author as author, g.dynasty as dynasty, g.full_text as poemText, f.fragment_text as fragmentText, f.fragment_order as fragmentOrder from game_poem_match_group g join game_poem_match_fragment f on g.id = f.group_id where g.level_id = #{levelId} and g.status = 1 and f.status = 1 order by g.sort_no asc, f.fragment_order asc, f.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into game_poem_match_record (user_id, level_id, score, matched_count, is_passed, used_seconds) values (#{userId}, #{levelId}, #{score}, #{matchedCount}, #{passed}, #{usedSeconds})
mapper.update: update sys_user set poem_match_score = ifnull(poem_match_score, 0) + #{score}, poem_match_correct_count = ifnull(poem_match_correct_count, 0) + #{matchedCount}, poem_match_pass_count = ifnull(poem_match_pass_count, 0) + #{passed}, game_total_score = ifnull(game_total_score, 0) + #{score}, game_updated_at = now() where id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select u.id as userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar_url as avatarUrl, ifnull(t.totalScore, 0) as totalScore, ifnull(t.totalScore, 0) as poemMatchScore, ifnull(t.correctCount, 0) as correctCount, ifnull(t.passCount, 0) as passCount from sys_user u left join ( select user_id, sum(ifnull(score, 0)) as totalScore, sum(ifnull(matched_count, 0)) as correctCount, sum(ifnull(is_passed, 0)) as passCount from game_poem_match_record where user_id is not null group by user_id ) t on u.id = t.user_id order by ifnull(t.totalScore, 0) desc, ifnull(t.correctCount, 0) desc, ifnull(t.passCount, 0) desc, u.id asc limit 20
